verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships the building blocks for research-agent output. Markdown conversion turns page links into a numbered reference list with clean citations. Schema and LLM-based extraction produce structured JSON, and adaptive, query-aware crawling (BM25, cosine filtering) decides when enough information has been gathered. However, the user has to assemble these pieces; the evidence shows no named preset tuned for research agents. Missing for 10: a documented one-step research-agent preset or profile, combined structured-plus-citable output from a single config, and independent hands-on corroboration.
